Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is a federal law enforcement agency that requires all applicants to undergo a thorough background investigation prior to employment in order to promote the agency's core values of vigilance, service to country, and integrity.

The United States Space Force (USSF) at Clear Space Force Station, Alaska is searching for a IT/Cyber COR/QA Program Manager to support 13 SWS (OBN) (NH-2210-03, GS-12/13 equivalent).

Description: Manages the Information Technology (IT)/Cyber Communications (Comm) Quality Assurance (QA) Program and performs QA evaluation and documentation of contractor performance.

Conducts inspections in Communications Operations, Computer Operations, Radar Maintenance, Computer Maintenance, Site Maintenance Management, LAN/WAN, Site Security Systems, Administrative Telephone Systems, and other assigned areas.

Determines contractor compliance with technical directives, quality, safety, timeliness, Air Force Instructions, and other contract requirements.

Develops the inspection schedule for contractor-supplied services and maintains/updates Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans (QASPs), Statements of Work (SOWs), contract modifications, inspection logs, and activity records.

Assesses policy needs and develops, approves, and interprets policy and procedures governing Information Technology (IT) and cybersecurity activities.

Serves as the Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM), establishing, maintaining, and enforcing the organization's cybersecurity program in accordance with the DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF), DoDI 8500.01, DoDI 8510.01, and applicable Air Force/Space Force cybersecurity guidance.

Interprets DoD, AF, and higher headquarters guidance and applies it locally, coordinating across organizations to develop, revise, and modify policies and assessing impacts on business requirements.

Manages the Assessment and Authorization (A&A) process, prepares and maintains system security authorization packages, and supports Authorizing Official (AO) decisions to achieve and sustain Authorizations to Operate (ATO) Provides technical expertise in the acquisition and installation of large, complex operating system environments, including personal computers, LAN servers, components, and associated software.

Independently oversees testing, migration, and cutover with minimal disruption and provides post-implementation support. Ensures appropriate configuration and sufficient system resources for new applications. Establishes project plans, priorities, and implementation schedules to ensure continuity of operations.

Evaluates operating system design requirements and consults with developers on impacts to end-user applications. Oversees hardware/software setup and configuration per the technical design plan, coordinating installation and sustainment with IT, telecommunications specialists, and the database manager.

Serves as the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) for the installation Comm/Cyber contract, performing contract administration duties designated in the CO's Letter of Designation.

Prepares Corrective Action Reports (CARs), documents deficiencies, analyzes contractor responses for root cause and corrective actions, and performs follow-up to resolution. Reviews technical specifications, requirements, and procurement request documents; leads technical proposal reviews; and determines adequacy of vendor capability.

Serves as liaison between the Commander, Contracting Officer, contractor, Director of Mission Assurance, and other Air Force/Space Force personnel.

Coordinates with the SCIF Manager, SSO, security personnel, and Authorizing Official chain on personnel access, SCI indoctrination, cybersecurity risk, and security incidents, violations, or deviations affecting information systems and the SCIF. Participates in meetings to resolve problems, discuss procedures, and review contractor performance.

Notifies the Senior Quality Assurance Evaluator, supervisor, and Contract Quality Program Manager of deficiencies, prepares file documentation, and recommends changes to surveillance methods as warranted.

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company.

We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

The Interoperability Implementation Manager is a key role responsible for ensuring successful EMR integrations with provider practices, including data exchange services (e.g. HL7/FHIR, Proprietary EMR APIs, CCDAs) and user-facing applications embedded within the EMR workflow.

This role focuses on turning technical EMR integration requirements into smooth, well-coordinated implementations that enable providers to efficiently and confidently adopt our data integration and interoperability products.

This role works closely with Client Success, Clinical Operations, Product, Engineering, and third-party EMR partners to plan and deliver implementations on time with high quality outcomes. This role combines project management, provider-facing communication, and tech savvy coordination, ownership, and bias for action to achieve project goals.

Responsibilities: Lead and actively participate in meetings with client/provider organization leadership, and internal teams, driving customer EMR integration implementations from planning through go-live and beyond, including SMART-on-FHIR applications, data integration services (HL7/FHIR, proprietary APIs), CCDA based data retrieval, and other EMR interoperability technologies Serve as primary point of contact with accountability for provider EMR integration success Partner with Customer Success team during pre-implementation scoping, planning, and readiness assessments (e.g. security questionnaires, IT resource allocation, governance)
Partner with Clinical Operations and Customer Success teams to align technical EMR integration implementation with other provider onboarding tasks
Manage the administrative backbone of implementation projects: taking detailed notes, tracking action items, timelines, decisions, entering and managing data into systems
Coordinate client teams and third-party partners (e.g., Epic, athena, Redox) Engage in cross-team collaboration, investigation, and issue resolution Manage project timelines, milestones, and delivery commitments Execute implementation and support tasks such as administrative set up, test data setup, system configuration, product demonstrations and training, issue investigation, and active problem solving Facilitate comprehensive testing in coordination with the full implementation team, including functional feature tests, comprehensive UAT, and production migration validation Troubleshoot issues and identify solutions, in collaboration with team colleagues Partner with Support Engineers on technical execution and support needs, including monitoring integration health and reporting applicable metrics Utilize standardized processes, templates, and self-service tools to scale efficiently Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies Accountable for communicating reliable and accurate project updates and related statuses to all project stakeholders and internal leadership Requirements Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in a related field 3+ years implementing complex healthcare software with provider practices 3+ years implementing integration technology (e.g.

Smart-on-FHIR apps, HL7/FHIR services) Clear understanding of provider workflows, risk adjustment, and quality of care Excellent project management and cross-functional coordination skills Excellent communication and expectation-setting skills with internal and external stakeholders, including technical and non-technical topics Proficient with technical integration products and concepts (APIs, data feeds, EMR config) Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with project stakeholders and leadership, including a variety of EMR integration and interoperability related topics and technologies Ability to manage multiple concurrent implementations High ownership mindset and bias toward hands-on execution Competencies: Communicates Effectively Exchanging ideas, knowledge, and data so that the message is received and understood with clarity and purpose.

Total Rewards of a Allied Health Professional The purpose of the Psychology Program Manager of the Telemental Health program is to provide independent clinical service delivery and administration of the Telemental Health Program within the Mental Health Service, as well as providing oversight and work assignments to the interdisciplinary staff working in the program.

Duties include, but are not limited to: Clinical. Uses telemental health modalities to provide a wide range of psychological assessment and diagnostic services for Veterans with a wide range of psychiatric disorders. Provides motivational enhancement activities to prepare Veterans to participate in clinically appropriate care.

Provides expert evidence-based psychotherapy services for Veterans including individual and group therapy, family/relationship counseling, and psychoeducation. Provides consultation to providers in the area of evidenced based interventions.

Promotes communication/interactions between medical team members, Veterans, and their families to facilitate the medical treatment process. Administrative, Supervisory and other Significant Responsibilities. Develops and coordinates services offered to Veterans and their families enrolled in the telemental health program.

Services include assessment, medication management, crisis intervention, educational, individual, family, and group treatment, case management and measurement-based care. Formulates, interprets, and implements policies and procedures pertaining to quality mental health care to assure compliance with internal and external performance standards.

Directs and guides various disciplines within the mental health service to assure efficiency, including the scheduling of activities, the redesign of workloads, daily monitoring of the operations of the program, and feedback to other managers about staff performance.

Evaluates current program services in a systematic manner, including the collection, tabulation, and presentation of program statistics, trends, and outcome measures.

Interfaces with other program managers, the Mental Health Leadership, and VA personnel regarding relevant programmatic issues with recommendations for improvement in service delivery and budgetary requests. Serves as a member of the Mental Health Total Quality Improvement Team.

Maintains productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders including but not limited to: VHA, VISN, Medical Center staff, labor partners, Veterans, and state organizations. Adjusts staffing levels or work procedures within the telemental health program to accommodate resource allocation decisions.

Leads regularly scheduled meetings (e.g., weekly) of the telemental health team to address issues and facilitate program planning.

Oversees the daily operation of the telemental health team (e.g., facilitate closing of encounters, processing of consults, facilitate communication with Health Administration Services (HAS) regarding pulling of scheduling of appointments, documentation and re- scheduling of missed appointments). Work Schedule: Monday - Friday 7:30 am - 4:00 pm.

Basic Requirements: United States Citizenship: Non-citizens may only be appointed when it is not possible to recruit qualified citizens in accordance with VA Policy. English Language Proficiency: Psychologists must be proficient in spoken and written English in accordance with VA Handbook 5005, Part II, Chapter 3, section A, paragraph 3j.

Education: Applicant must have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA), the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS), or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed.

The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR, Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully completed a re-specialization program meeting both of the following conditions: a) the re-specialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and b) the specialty in which you were retrained is consistent with the assignment; OR, Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution, with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature.

AND, Internship: Candidate must have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed; OR New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement, provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern; OR, VHA facilities that offered full-time, one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96-151 (pre-1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement; OR, Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

(NOTE: Once board certified, the employee is required to maintain board certification).OR, Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program.

If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript, the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program.

NOTE: Psychologists who meet the requirements of this revision and who were employed by the Department of Veterans Affairs prior to the implementation of this standard are considered to have fully met the requirements of this qualification standard.

Licensure: Candidates must hold a full, current, and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State, Territory or Commonwealth of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

At least three years of experience as a professional psychologist, with at least one year equivalent to the GS-13 grade level. Example of experience at the GS-13 level include: 1. Knowledge of, and ability to apply, professional psychological treatments to the full range of patient populations; 2.

Ability to provide professional advice and consultation in areas related to professional psychology and behavioral health; and 3. Knowledge of clinical research literature. And, Demonstrated Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs).

In addition to the experience above, the candidate must demonstrate all of the following KSAs: Ability to organize work, set priorities, delegate tasks, and meet multiple deadlines. Knowledge of and ability to utilize evidence based practices and clinical practice guidelines appropriately and ability to guide staff in using these tools.

Ability to deal effectively with individuals or groups. Skill in managing and directing the work of others to accomplish program goals and objectives. Ability to translate management goals and objectives into well-coordinated and controlled work operations. Ability to establish and monitor production and performance priorities and standards.

Ability to analyze organizational and operational problems and to develop and implement solutions that result in sound operation of the program. Preferred Experience: Experience working as a leader or member of a multidisciplinary team. Experience analyzing data, identifying trends, and preparing reports for leaders and interdisciplinary teams.

Experience coaching and educating teams at multiple levels of the organization. Strong oral and written communication skills. Reference: For more information on this qualification standard, please visit https://www.va.gov/ohrm/QualificationStandards/. The full performance level of this vacancy is GS-14.

May be required to wear personal protective equipment and undergo annual TB screening or testing as conditions of employment. Work Environment: Work is performed in an office/clinic setting with minimal risks that requires normal safety precautions; the area is adequately lighted, heated, and ventilated.

However, the work environment requires someone with the ability to handle several tasks at once in sometimes stressful situations.

At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization.

If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
We are looking to add a Senior Program Manager to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and managing multiple fast paced projects at once, we would like to hear from you.
In this position, you will be responsible for program performance and day-to-day execution for a large customer subsystem or a small to medium sized payload, including concept development, implementation, production, modification, integration and test, and delivery. You will be the single point of contact for customer interactions including program management reviews, customer bi-weekly reviews, and major program reviews. This position is expected to be able to manage multiple customers.
This position works collaboratively with all functional organizations at CesiumAstro to ensure the success of the program using risk -bsaed decision making in guiding decisions to meet program objectives. A successful candidate understands how to effectively use program and engineering metrics to make data driven decisions. You will serve as the primary program leader for all activities, with responsibilities for cost, schedule, and adherence to technical performance requirements.
The Senior Program Manager will establish program management baselines (integrated master plans and resource loaded schedules) to task the team, measures program performance, and monitors progress to generate latest revised estimates and estimates to completion. The Senior Program Manager will provide these inputs to customers, CesiumAstro leadership, and internal finance teams for revenue recognition.
This position will assist the Director of Programs in improving standard processes, and implementing best practices for consistency across the Space Payloads portfolio of programs. As a senior member of the program team, you may help in hiring and mentorship of program engineers.

Minimum of 12-15 years of Program Management or Subcontract Management Experience.
Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in a relevant engineering field (Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, etc.) from an accredited university or institution.
Experience in the aerospace industry as a system or design engineer.
Develop and coordinate program requirements across product lines and with multiple subcontractors
Familiarity with RF, communication, or satellite systems.
Experience managing cross functional and decentralized teams.
Relevant CAM, risk management, EVMS, and risk based assessment experience.
Experience developing work break down structures, integrated master plans, and integrated master schedules.
Experience managing programs with dynamic and multi-project interdependencies.
Return-To-Green experience on one or more programs.
Experience in NRE development programs.
Excellent organizational skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Must be able to work in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment
Experience working with government/military customers.

Experience working with proliferated architectures
Experience in DoD Acquisition Process.
Program Manager Professional (PMP) Certified.

## Abteilungsleitung Offene Jugendarbeit Zentrum ##
Ihre neue Rolle
Sie übernehmen die personelle, fachliche, organisatorische und finanzielle Führung der Offenen Jugendarbeit Zentrum und gestalten deren Weiterentwicklung aktiv mit. Gemeinsam mit dem Team sorgen Sie für eine zeitgemässe, bedarfsgerechte und zukunftsorientierte Ausrichtung der Offenen Jugendarbeit in der Stadt St.Gallen.
Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung der Dienststelle Kinder Jugend Familie bringen Sie jugendrelevante Themen ein, wirken an strategischen Entscheidungen mit und vertreten die Anliegen von Jugendlichen und jungen Erwachsenen innerhalb der städtischen Strukturen.
Gleichzeitig bleiben Sie nah an der Praxis: Sie arbeiten bei Bedarf in den verschiedenen Angeboten der Offenen Jugendarbeit Zentrum mit, begleiten Projekte und Aktionen gemeinsam mit Jugendlichen und unterstützen Ihr Team in der Umsetzung innovativer und partizipativer Angebote.

Sie fördern die Zusammenarbeit mit Schulen, Fachstellen, Vereinen, Institutionen und weiteren Partnerorganisationen und tragen durch gezielte Öffentlichkeitsarbeit zur Sichtbarkeit und Weiterentwicklung der Offenen Jugendarbeit bei. Darüber hinaus verantworten Sie die Budgetplanung und den sorgfältigen Einsatz der finanziellen Mittel der Abteilung.
Unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten sowie Einsätze an Abenden und vereinzelt an Wochenenden gehören punktuell zu dieser Funktion.
Diese Stelle ist für Sie, wenn Sie
* ein Fachhochschuldiplom in Sozialer Arbeit haben oder über eine vergleichbare Ausbildung verfügen.
* mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Offenen Kinder- und Jugendarbeit mitbringen.
* Führungserfahrung oder ausgewiesene Führungskompetenzen besitzen.
* Partizipation mit der Zielgruppe sowie den Mitarbeitenden als selbstverständlich erachten.
* strategisches Denken mit Praxisnähe verbinden können.
* Freude daran haben, Mitarbeitende zu fördern, zu entwickeln und gemeinsam Ziele zu erreichen.
* Erfahrung in der Projektentwicklung und Projektleitung mitbringen.
* über hohe Sozial-, Kommunikations- und Vernetzungskompetenzen verfügen.
* sicher auftreten und unterschiedlichste Anspruchsgruppen adressatengerecht ansprechen können.
* Verantwortung für Finanzen, Budgetierung und Ressourcenplanung übernehmen möchten.
* flexibel sind und die Bereitschaft mitbringen, sich sowohl auf strategischer als auch auf operativer Ebene einzubringen.
Ihre Arbeitgeberin
Die Dienststelle Kinder Jugend Familie ist eine Fachstelle für Kinder und Jugendliche zwischen 6 und 26 Jahren, deren Bezugspersonen und weitere interessierte Erwachsene. Sie übernimmt Aufgaben wie Beratung, Abgabe von Informationen, Unterstützung bei Ideen sowie Begleitung von Angeboten der Freizeitgestaltung.
Die Abteilung Offene Jugendarbeit Zentrum der Dienststelle Kinder Jugend und Familie der Stadt St. Gallen stellt im Stadtzentrum vielfältige Freizeitangebote bereit. Mit Einrichtungen wie der Jugendbeiz talhof, dem Jugendkulturraum flon, den flonateliers sowie der Mobilen Jugendarbeit leistet sie einen bedeutenden Beitrag zur Jugendkultur in St. Gallen.
Unsere Unternehmenskultur
Sie arbeiten in einem wertschätzenden Klima, welches geprägt ist von gegenseitigem Vertrauen, Respekt und Loyalität. Unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter fördern wir aufgrund ihrer individuellen Fähigkeiten und Ressourcen.
Das bieten wir
Die Stadt St.Gallen unterstützt die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf, Familie und anderen Lebensbereichen. Daher bieten wir flexible Arbeitsmodelle und familienfreundliche Zulagen. In unserem internen Weiterbildungsprogramm finden Sie interessante Angebote für Ihre berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

The Agile Delivery Manager (ADM) is accountable for delivering business value across one or more agile teams, specifically in support of the organization’s digital transformation.

Acting as a servant leader and connector between strategic intent and operational execution, the ADM sits at the bridge point between the product/feature layer (Product Owners, Business Analysts, Business Owners) and the delivery layer (Engineering Managers, Developers, QA, and the Scrum Masters who own team-level performance).

The ADM ensures that delivery aligns with product roadmaps, value streams, and enterprise priorities.
This role is not about managing tasks—it’s about enabling flow, clarity, and measurable outcomes that advance the organization’s customer and business goals. The ADM owns the health and predictability of the Program Increment (PI): making sure it is planned well, tracked honestly, and delivered against — while escalating risks and dependencies before they become blockers. .

s.h: The role is responsible for the following results
s.t:
Delivery Flow and Value
Consistently leveraging lean and agile practices to achieve outcomes, not just complete output.
Orchestrate planning and coordination activities across multiple teams, including PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums and cross-team synchronization, and protecting the teams against interference and over commitment, to sustain focus and health velocity.
Advise Product Owners and Business Analysts in backlog management and sequencing to ensure clear cross-team prioritization.
Monitor flow and delivery health metrics (predictability, throughput, cycle time, PI objective achievement) and share them with teams to celebrate progress and surface improvement opportunities
Use performance and progress data to increase transparency and predictability in meeting commitments to the business.
Facilitate the adoption and evolution of agile practices to continuously improve how the organization produces high quality and high value outcomes.
Align teams with strategic goals through transparent sequencing of work, clear identification of cross-team dependencies; own the identification, tracking, and mitigation of delivery risks and issues, ensuring timely resolution or escalation.
Facilitate scaled/cross-team agile events (e.g., PI Planning, System Demo, Inspect & Adapt, Scrum of Scrums) so they are productive and time-boxed, setting a consistent standard of effectiveness across teams. Team-level ceremonies remain owned by Scrum Masters. Ensure delivery standards and definitions of done are applied consistently across the teams.
Enablement & Coaching
Coach Scrum Masters, Business Owners, Product Owners and Business Analysts to communicated in terms of value delivered rather than requirement fulfillment.
Guide continuous improvement through retrospectives, delivery health checks, and root-cause analysis at the multi-team and PI Levels
Build agile maturity through mentoring, modeling psychological safety, and reenforcing learning cycles.
Stakeholder Engagement
Translate delivery progress into business impact, reporting what value was realized, not just completed.
Own upward and outward communication of delivery status, risks, and PI outcomes to executives, business owners, the Governance & Transformation Lead, and technology leadership.
Ensure the “voice of delivery” is represented in strategic planning and portfolio discussions.

PI predictability (planned vs. delivered PI objectives) across teams in scope.
Flow metrics trend (cycle time, throughput, work-in-progress) shared and improving over time.
Time-to-resolution on escalated risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies.

Position Summary Prometheus Federal Services (PFS) is a trusted partner of federal health agencies. We are seeking a Technical Project Manager to support the Veterans Healthcare Administration (VHA). This role will provide leadership, coordination, and oversight for program activities supporting healthcare scheduling modernization, interoperability, workflow transformation, training, adoption, and operational sustainment across VA and Community Care environments.
The Technical Project Manager will serve as the primary point of coordination across stakeholders, technical teams, operational leaders, and program executives to ensure successful delivery of complex healthcare transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess significant healthcare program management experience, strong leadership skills, and a demonstrated ability to manage enterprise-scale implementations in highly regulated environments.
Essential Functions
Reasonable Accommodations Statement
To succeed in this job, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential duty. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities Program Leadership & Strategic Oversight
Lead planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout activities for enterprise healthcare transformation initiatives.
Provide program leadership and strategic direction across multiple workstreams supporting scheduling modernization, interoperability, workflow optimization, and operational adoption.
Establish and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and execution roadmaps.
Manage program governance processes, decision tracking, risk mitigation, issue management, and executive reporting activities.
Ensure alignment of program objectives with VA strategic priorities, healthcare modernization initiatives, and Veteran access goals.
Healthcare Scheduling Modernization
Support implementation and sustainment activities associated with the Enterprise Patient Scheduling (EPS) platform and related scheduling modernization initiatives.
Coordinate efforts across scheduling, referral management, care coordination, provider network integration, and interoperability workstreams.
Monitor implementation progress and identify opportunities to improve operational effectiveness, scheduling efficiency, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to streamline business processes and improve scheduling workflows.
Ensure delivery activities support the enterprise vision of unified scheduling across direct care, community care, virtual care, and Veteran self-scheduling channels.
Stakeholder Engagement & Executive Communications
Serve as the primary liaison among program leadership, VA stakeholders, clinical operations teams, technical teams, and external partners.
Prepare executive briefings, dashboards, status reports, issue analyses, and program updates.
Facilitate governance meetings, leadership reviews, strategic planning sessions, and working groups.
Develop communications that effectively translate complex technical and operational information for diverse stakeholder audiences.
Establish collaborative relationships with stakeholders to build consensus and support program objectives.
Change Management, Training & Adoption
Lead organizational change management activities supporting enterprise deployment and adoption initiatives.
Develop and execute stakeholder engagement, communication, training, and adoption strategies.
Coordinate training development and delivery efforts, including user guides, job aids, onboarding materials, and role-based training programs.
Monitor adoption, utilization, and performance metrics to assess program effectiveness and support continuous improvement activities.
Identify organizational impacts, potential resistance points, and mitigation strategies to increase successful adoption of new processes and technologies.
Support site readiness assessments, activation planning, post-deployment support, and lessons learned activities.
Interoperability, Process Improvement & Operational Excellence
Support healthcare interoperability initiatives involving scheduling, referral management, provider data exchange, and care coordination capabilities.
Oversee business process analysis and workflow improvement efforts to optimize operational outcomes.
Coordinate solution engineering and issue resolution activities among technical and operational stakeholders.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement by identifying performance gaps and recommending corrective actions.
Support performance measurement, quality management, operational readiness assessments, and program maturity initiatives.
Risk Management & Compliance
Identify, assess, and manage program risks, issues, dependencies, and resource constraints.
Ensure compliance with applicable federal, VA, privacy, security, and governance requirements.
Support audit readiness, documentation management, and quality assurance activities.
Maintain accountability for program deliverables, performance outcomes, and contractual commitments.

Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, Public Health, Business Administration, Information Systems, Program Management, or a related field. Master's Degree preferred.
Minimum of 6 years of experience managing healthcare programs, initiatives, or enterprise transformation efforts.
Demonstrated experience planning, managing, executing, and closing complex healthcare programs.
Experience supporting integrated healthcare delivery systems, healthcare modernization initiatives, or large-scale healthcare technology implementations.
Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and cross-functional teams.
Strong understanding of healthcare operations, clinical workflows, and healthcare technology implementations.
Experience leading organizational change management and adoption initiatives.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level briefing development and presentation experience.
Experience with program governance, risk management, performance measurement, and continuous improvement methodologies.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project/program management certification.
Authorized to work in the U.S. indefinitely without sponsorship.
Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), or other federal healthcare agencies.
Experience supporting scheduling modernization, referral management, community care programs, or healthcare interoperability initiatives.
Familiarity with healthcare standards, APIs, interoperability frameworks, and health information exchange concepts.
Experience leading enterprise-wide deployments, adoption programs, and operational transformation initiatives across geographically dispersed organizations.
Experience working in Agile, hybrid, or large-scale program management environments.

Abteilungsleiterin / Abteilungsleiter Pflege 100%

Sie sind Pflegefachperson aus Überzeugung und gleichzeitig gerne Führungspersönlichkeit. Sie möchten nicht nur verwalten, sondern **mitgestalten und etwas bewegen**.
* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachperson HF

Senior Program Manager, Data Security & Information Governance
Why We Have This Role
We’re hiring a Senior Program Manager, Data Security & Information Governance to establish, scale, and orchestrate our enterprise Information Governance program. You’ll sit at the intersection of Legal, Data & Technology Operations, and Enterprise Data, bridging the gap between business strategy, legal compliance, data security, and engineering.

Rather than acting as a traditional gatekeeper, you will build and manage our "Data Front Door" to directly address how teams discover data rights, request entitlements, and explore novel data use cases safely and efficiently.
How You’ll Find Success
Governance Framework & Tooling Strategy: Deep fluency in establishing enterprise data governance frameworks, data catalogs, and business glossaries that scale across high-growth SaaS environments.
Operational Enablement: Proven capability to design centralized intake and triage processes ("Data Front Door") that convert complex legal and security constraints into frictionless, self-service internal workflows.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Ability to bridge legal compliance (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA) with technical access controls (RBAC/ABAC, tokenization), working seamlessly alongside engineering, security, and product teams.
Proactive Execution: Takes initiative to define the "how" in ambiguous regulatory or operational spaces, driving cross-functional alignment and resolving data policy conflicts across teams.
Adaptive Curiosity: A drive to stay ahead of evolving data privacy laws, security architectures, and novel AI/ML data use cases to keep our governance models modern and flexible.
How You’ll Grow
Master Enterprise Data Architecture: Expand your expertise across cloud data architectures (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS/GCP) and automated metadata pipelines to build modern, tech-enabled governance structures.
Bridge Legal and Engineering Operations: Deepen your technical competency in access management (Okta, Immuta, Privacera) and data security capabilities, dissolving the divide between legal strategy and technical execution.
Influence Platform Scale: Set the patterns and primitives for data use across a platform serving 18K+ global clients, ensuring data minimization, privacy-by-design, and compliant AI experimentation.
Things You’ll Do
Build the "Data Front Door": Design and manage a centralized intake and triage process for custom data access requests, novel data questions, and complex derivative work inquiries.
Curate the Data Marketplace: Establish a centralized Use Case Repository and Data Marketplace detailing pre-approved data uses, restrictions, and licensing parameters across distinct datasets.
Automate Metadata & Classification: Partner with engineering and security teams to implement automated data classification, lineage tracking, and metadata harvesting.
Translate Policy into Technical Controls: Collaborate with InfoSec to operationalize legal requirements into enforced technical access controls (RBAC/ABAC) and row/column-level security protocols.
Drive Governance Adoption: Measure program success through adoption KPIs, request turnaround times, and governance maturity metrics, delivering self-service documentation and onboarding across the org.

s.h: What We’re Looking For On Your Resume
s.t:
5+ years of experience in Data Governance, Data Security, Data Operations, or Information Architecture within a high-growth technology, SaaS, or data-intensive organization.
Deep understanding of data privacy and security frameworks (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA) and commercial data licensing nuances.
Direct experience setting up, configuring, or administering enterprise data governance & catalog tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation, DataGalaxy, Atlan).
Technical aptitude with cloud data ecosystems (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS/GCP), SQL, and data security mechanisms (hashing, tokenization, differential privacy).
Demonstrated ability to create business-friendly, self-service workflows that accelerate R&D and AI/ML initiatives while ensuring strict compliance.
Preferred certifications: CDMP, CIPP/US, CIPT, CDPSE, CISSP, or CISM.
What You Should Know About This Team
Enablement Over Gatekeeping: We view governance as a business driver. Our goal is to make doing the right thing with data the easiest path for our product, engineering, and business teams.
Cross-Functional Influence: You will sit at the crossroads of Legal, InfoSec, and Platform Engineering, serving as the connective tissue that translates legal policies into automated technical realities.
Built for Scale: As Qualtrics expands its AI and data capabilities, you will build the foundational governance frameworks that ensure our growth remains safe, ethical, and fully compliant.
Why you’ll want to join us: Most design teams are talking about AI; we are the ones building the engine that powers it. If you want to bridge the gap between design and development, thrive in high-autonomy environments, and see your code directly power intelligent experiences for 18K+ global clients, this is the place to be. We don’t just design the future—we code it, test it, and ship it.

## Job Description ##
In this role, you will support the day-to-day management and improvement of HR policies, processes and practices.

You will help translate legal, regulatory and internal requirements into practical HR procedures.
You will follow relevant changes, identify which documents or processes need to be adapted and coordinate updates with the appropriate specialists.
A key part of the position will be process improvement.
You will review how existing HR processes work in practice, gather feedback from users, identify recurring issues and propose practical adjustments.
You will also use available data and KPIs to monitor processes and identify areas where efficiency or service quality can be improved.
You will work closely with different HR teams to support the implementation and consistent application of policies and procedures.
This may include answering questions, clarifying processes, preparing guidance and helping colleagues and managers understand how policies should be applied in practice.
You will coordinate a range of HR projects and improvement initiatives.
Your responsibilities will include preparing project plans, organising meetings and workshops, following up on actions, coordinating contributors, tracking deadlines and deliverables and ensuring that agreed changes are implemented.
You will organise and facilitate working sessions with relevant stakeholders to gather requirements, review existing practices and agree on practical solutions.
You will also support the rollout of new or updated HR policies and processes.
This includes coordinating validation, preparing implementation materials and working with communication colleagues to ensure that information is clear, accessible and available to the relevant audiences.
The position requires regular coordination with multiple stakeholders and the ability to manage several topics simultaneously while ensuring accurate follow-up and documentation.
## The Successful Applicant ##
We are looking for an experienced HR professional who enjoys working on concrete HR processes, policies and projects and who is comfortable moving between detailed documentation and stakeholder coordination.
You bring several years of HR experience, ideally within a large international organisation.
You have practical experience working with HR policies, procedures, process improvement and HR projects.
You hold a university degree or equivalent higher education qualification.
An additional HR qualification and familiarity with the Swiss employment and regulatory environment would be an advantage.
You are comfortable reviewing HR policies and procedures, understanding regulatory requirements and translating them into clear documentation and workable processes.
You have good project coordination skills and are used to managing actions, timelines, documentation and multiple stakeholders. You are comfortable organising meetings and workshops, following up on decisions and ensuring that agreed actions are completed.

Accuracy and attention to detail are important for this position.
You are comfortable working directly on policies, guidelines, templates, forms and process documentation and can ensure information remains consistent and up to date.
You communicate clearly and can work effectively with HR colleagues, managers and other internal stakeholders.
You are comfortable explaining processes, gathering feedback and coordinating different inputs to reach workable solutions.
Organised and autonomous, you can manage several activities at the same time, prioritise effectively and follow topics through to completion.
Fluency in French and English is required.
## What's on Offer ##
This is a varied and hands-on HR role where you will work directly on policies, processes, documentation and improvement projects.
You will have the opportunity to see the practical results of your work and contribute to making HR processes clearer and easier to use for employees, managers and HR teams.
You will join an international and collaborative working environment and interact with a broad range of HR specialists and internal stakeholders.
The position offers a good mix of operational HR work, project coordination and continuous improvement.

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager in Facility Management (m/f/d) to join our Facility Management team at our Reinach site and help further develop a sustainable, modern, and future-oriented infrastructure.

Would you like to independently manage demanding technical projects? Are you motivated to actively contribute to the Energy Strategy 2030+ at our campus? * contribute your expertise in building services systems and provide targeted support to colleagues in operations and maintenance.

* ideally bring knowledge of CAD tools and the building management platform DesigoCC.
* are fluent in German (spoken and written); English skills are an advantage.
* think conceptually, act in a solution-oriented manner, and communicate clearly and convincingly.
* enjoy working in a team and are motivated to make a difference together with others.
